agendas.title: {name} wants to back a venture
agendas.text: {name} has met a man with a scheme for a mill on the Nidda and asks for {cost} to buy into it.
agendas.won_text: The mill pays: {name} brings back {payout} to the house.
agendas.lost_text: The mill comes to nothing, and the money with it.

agendas.title: {name} asks for a gift to the poor
agendas.text: {name} asks that the house give {cost} to the orphanage, in the family's name.
agendas.grant_text: The gift is made, and the city hears of it.
agendas.refuse_text: {name} is told the house cannot spare it.

agendas.title: {name} wants a match for {member}
agendas.text: {name} writes that {member} is of age and unmarried, and that {house} would welcome the match.
agendas.refuse_text: {name} is told to wait, and does not take it well.

agendas.title: {name} wants a desk in the counting house
agendas.text: {name} asks to work in the counting house as a clerk, at the usual wage.
agendas.grant_text: {name} takes a desk among the clerks.
agendas.refuse_text: {name} is told the desks are for clerks.

agendas.title: {name} asks for an allowance
agendas.text: {name} has debts with a tailor and a wine merchant, and asks the house for {cost}
agendas.refuse_text: {name} is told to settle them alone.

split.title: {name} means to leave the house
split.text: {name} writes that the house has no place for them, and that they mean to open a bank of their own.
split.buy_off_text: {name} is persuaded to stay, at a price.
split.leave_text: {name} leaves to found {house}, taking {capital} of capital and {deposits} of deposits.

claims.title: {name} claims a share of the house
claims.text: {name}, passed over for {head}, claims {amount} as their due from the house.
claims.pay_text: The claim is paid, and {name} is reconciled.
claims.law_won_text: The court dismisses {name}'s claim. The bourse talks of it.
claims.law_lost_text: The court finds for {name}: the house pays {amount}.
claims.refuse_text: {name}'s claim is refused. A feud begins.

feuds.title: {name} offers terms
feuds.text: {name} will end the quarrel with {head} for {amount}.
feuds.ended_death_text: With {head} dead, {name}'s feud is buried with them.
feuds.cooled_text: Three years on, {name} and {head} have stopped speaking of their quarrel.

studies.name: University (law)
studies.start_text: {name} goes to Heidelberg to read law.
studies.return_text: {name} returns from Heidelberg with a doctorate in law.

studies.name: Apprenticeship in London
studies.start_text: {name} sails for London, to learn the trade in a merchant bank there.
studies.return_text: {name} returns from London, knowing bills of exchange as few in Frankfurt do.

studies.name: An officer's commission
studies.start_text: {name} takes a commission in the Austrian service.
studies.return_text: {name} returns from the army, upright and well known at court.

studies.name: The counting house
studies.start_text: {name} starts at a stool in the counting house.
studies.return_text: {name} has learned the books from the clerks.
